name: Weak Donkey 85
author: AmIt-DasIT
description: Outlined white text input that lights up when focused.
howItWorks:
On focus, border becomes 2px solid transparent, text color changes from #fff to #fff, box-shadow becomes 3px 3px 10px #000000,
  -1px -1px 6px #ffffff,
  inset 3px 3px 10px #000000,
  inset -1px -1px 6px #ffffff.
